summary: RDS (Retail Data Systems), founded in 1950 and operating 30+ offices across North America, is a POS hardware/software reseller and integrator that sells and services multiple restaurant POS platforms, including NCR Aloha, Maitre'D, and Global Payments' own Genius Enterprise Restaurant POS. (Scope note: RDS is a multi-brand POS reseller/dealer, not a proprietary competing software platform — it resells Genius POS itself alongside rival platforms such as NCR Aloha, so its relationship to Genius is partly channel/partner and partly reseller-of-rivals.)

RDS's restaurant product line spans POS, back-office software, kitchen production systems, inventory and labor management, reporting/analytics, gift cards, online ordering, digital signage, and marketing services, sold and installed through a regional dealer network.

Robust verified restaurant-operator review coverage specific to RDS implementation/support was not found; the main negative evidence located was technician-side and remains intentionally low-confidence.
